description: Allows a jukebox directly below this block to use its existing container as a playlist source. This component is an empty object. It does not create a container and has no effect without one. Requires format_version 1.26.60 or later and the Upcoming Creator Features experiment. To enable it conditionally, define it only in the relevant permutations; omitting it from a permutation does not remove it from the base components.
title: Jukebox Playlist Source
